title: Financial Planning & Analysis Manager
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit  fluenceenergy.com .

Job Description:
EMPLOYER: Fluence Energy, LLC

TITLE: Financial Planning & Analysis Manager

LOCATION: 4601 Fairfax Drive, Suite 600, Arlington, VA 22203

DUTIES: Lead the budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes, ensuring alignment with corporate financial goals and performance targets. Serve as a Finance Business Partner to cross-functional teams, providing financial insights and strategic analysis to support decision-making across operations. Own the administration, maintenance, and optimization of financial planning and analysis (FP&A) tools, including Anaplan, Oracle Hyperion Planning (NSPB), and Salesforce for financial data integration and reporting. Lead or support the rollout of finance-related systems and process enhancements to improve efficiency, data accuracy, and timeliness of reporting. Perform ad hoc financial analysis, reporting, and business modeling in response to evolving business needs, market conditions, and leadership requests. Lead preparation of monthly MBR (i.e. Management/Monthly Business Review) presentation: synthesizing monthly deliverable outputs and driving cross-functional inputs (e.g. Commercial, Supply Chain, etc.) included. US GAAP and External Reporting: work with Corporate Accounting to publish "supplemental external metrics" as part of quarterly earnings release covering various financial and operational metrics (e.g. assets under management, adjusted EBITDA GAAP to non-GAAP reconciliation, etc.). Lead preparation and distribution of quarterly forecast update to related parties (i.e. Siemens and AES) per existing process to support their budgeting requirements.

REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field and 2 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or a related field.

Experience must include two (2) years of experience in each of the following:

- End-to-end budgeting and forecasting processes, including variance analysis and scenario modeling;

- Administering or supporting financial planning tools such as Anaplan, Oracle Hyperion Planning (NSPB), SAP BPC, or equivalent enterprise performance management (EPM) systems;

- Data extraction and management of big data from ERP systems (such as NetSuite or SAP) for analysis and data integration with project forecasting tool;

- Strategic financial insights to support decision-making across operations, supply chain, and commercial teams;

- Preparing external financial reports and reconciliations between GAAP and non-GAAP metrics;

- Overseeing the full lifecycle of financial system implementations and enhancements, including requirements gathering, testing, and change management.

Experience must include one (1) year of experience with coordinating and delivering forecasts and supplemental reporting external stakeholders.

SALARY:  $114,000 to $144,500 per year

TO APPLY: E-mail resume to Srivatsa.Upadhyaya@fluenceenergy.com. Please reference Job Code 9303916.

description:

Job Description:

Role Overview
The Role Requires 4 days in the office.

The Training & Development Manager owns the design, development, and administration of Fluence's onboarding and continuous learning programs. This role combines instructional design and content development with hands-on Learning Management System (LMS) administration, live facilitation, SOP creation, and scalable video production. Reporting to the Director of Sales Training & Development, this role ensures employees across the organization have access to accurate, engaging, and up-to-date training content, and that the LMS operates with integrity and reliability.
Key Responsibilities
Content Developer / Instructional Designer

- Develop & maintain content for onboarding and continuous learning programs & initiatives.

- Modularize new training content for all roles within the LMS.

- Keep relevant content updated on the Lightning SharePoint site.

- Build interactive course content using Articulate 360 Rise (required) to create engaging, scalable e-learning modules.

LMS Administration

- Maintain LMS integrity i.e. active users, course assignment, and permissions.

- Generate and distribute reports on training completion, compliance, and program effectiveness to stakeholders.

- Serve as the primary LMS administrator (Absorb preferred), troubleshooting issues and optimizing system use.

Facilitation (as needed)

- Facilitate live and virtual sessions for onboarding and continuous learning programs across roles and departments.

- Partner with subject matter experts to ensure training sessions are current, relevant, and effectively delivered.

SOP Creation (Scribe)

- Create and maintain SOPs and process documentation using Scribe.

- Ensure SOPs are accessible and integrated into onboarding and training materials.

Video Creation & Editing (Synthesia & Adobe Premiere)

- Produce and edit training videos using Synthesia and Adobe Premiere (both required) to support scalable, role-specific learning content.

- Continuously refine video-based content to improve learner engagement and retention.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Program Alignment

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams when needed, including project managers, content specialists, Marketing, and other key stakeholders to ensure successful project implementation.

- Maintain a working knowledge of client practice models, evidence-based approaches, and applicable federal and state policies to ensure learning solutions align with program requirements and industry best practices.

- Monitor emerging trends in instructional design, workforce development, adult learning, and human services to inform innovative learning strategies.

- Manage Microsoft Teams & calendar scheduling for virtual training sessions, webinars, and calendar invites using Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Teams.

What We're Looking For
Experience

- 3-5 years of instructional design & content development experience required, including developing and modularizing training content for onboarding and continuous learning programs.

- Articulate 360 Rise experience required for building interactive, scalable e-learning course content.

- LMS Administration experience highly preferred, including user management, course creation, and report generation.

- Facilitation: Demonstrated experience facilitating live or virtual training sessions for varied audiences.

- Process Documentation: Experience creating SOPs and process documentation using Scribe or similar tools.

- Video Production: Experience producing and editing training videos using Synthesia and Adobe Premiere (both required).

- Content Management: Experience maintaining training content on SharePoint or similar platforms.

Skills, Competencies & Mindset

- Instructional Design: Strong understanding of adult learning principles and the ability to translate complex information into clear, modular training content.

- Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to maintaining LMS data integrity, permissions, and reporting accuracy.

- Communication & Facilitation: Comfortable presenting to and engaging audiences across all levels of the organization.

- Technical Aptitude: Quick to learn and apply new tools and platforms, including the LMS, Scribe, Synthesia, Adobe Premiere, Articulate 360 Rise, and SharePoint.

- Project Management: Able to manage multiple content development projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.

- Collaboration: Works effectively with subject matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders, including project managers, content specialists, and Marketing, to gather content and validate accuracy.

- Industry & Compliance Knowledge: Working knowledge of client practice models, evidence-based approaches, and applicable federal and state policies relevant to program requirements.

- Trend Awareness: Stays current on emerging trends in instructional design, workforce development, adult learning, and human services.

- Microsoft Teams & Calendar Management: Proficiency in scheduling, managing, and coordinating virtual training sessions, webinars, and calendar invites using Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft Teams.

Nice to Have

- Experience supporting Sales training or onboarding programs.

- Familiarity with Absorb LMS specifically.

- Experience with additional video or content creation tools (e.g., Camtasia, Adobe After Effects).

Success Metrics

- Timely development and modularization of training content for new and existing roles.

- High LMS data integrity, with accurate user records, course assignments, and permissions.

- Consistent, on-time report generation and distribution to stakeholders.

- Positive learner feedback and engagement on facilitated sessions and video content.

- Up-to-date, easily accessible content on the Lightning SharePoint site and current SOPs in Scribe.

This dynamic role connects you with diverse stakeholders—from internal teams to customers, suppliers and contractors—requiring your financial acumen to translate complex project economics into actionable insights. Your background in accounting/finance with infrastructure projects and contract management will position you as an invaluable asset to our organization.

·       Oversee project contract administration, establishing streamlined processes that enhance financial transparency
·       Partner with project managers to provide real-time visibility into project budgets and financial performance

·       Minimum 3 years' experience managing construction projects and long-term service contracts (energy industry experience preferred)
·       Comprehensive understanding of project lifecycle activities and financial implications
·       Exceptional attention to detail with superior time and project management capabilities
·       Advanced contract management skills with negotiation experience
·       Proficiency with SAP, Unifier and other corporate financial systems
·       Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively
·       Advanced proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
·       Willingness to travel up to 20% as projects require
·       Fluency in both English and Polish

title: Program Manager, Prevailing Wage Compliance (PWA)
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit  fluenceenergy.com .

Job Description:
Role Overview
Fluence is seeking a Program Manager, Prevailing Wage Compliance (PWA) to lead the end-to-end management of prevailing wage and labor compliance data across grid-scale energy storage projects. This role is responsible for ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local labor requirements, including the Davis-Bacon Act. The Program Manager will serve as the central point of coordination for all incoming compliance data from subcontractors, third-party vendors, and internal teams, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely submission. This role requires strong program management discipline, data governance expertise, and the ability to operate across a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Own and manage Fluence’s prevailing wage (PWA) compliance program across active projects in North America, ensuring adherence to federal, state, and local labor compliance requirements. Establish and enforce standardized processes for certified payroll collection, validation, and submission, and serve as the internal subject matter expert on prevailing wage compliance requirements.

- Act as the central intake point for all compliance-related data from subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams. Implement and manage systems such as LCP Tracker and Points North to collect, track, and audit required data. Review certified payrolls and supporting documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance risks, ensuring alignment with internal systems such as Workday employee IDs and project coding structures. Identify discrepancies and proactively resolve issues.

- Partner with subcontractors and third-party vendors to ensure timely and compliant data submissions. Provide clear guidance on documentation requirements and submission timelines, monitor performance against SLAs, and escalate non-compliance as needed to drive resolution.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with HR, Legal, Payroll, Finance, Procurement, and Project Management teams to align compliance processes with internal systems and workflows. Act as a liaison between field operations and corporate functions to ensure seamless compliance execution.

- Prepare and submit required compliance reports to government agencies and customers. Maintain audit-ready documentation to support internal and external audits. Track and report on compliance metrics, risks, and trends, and identify opportunities to improve processes, including automation and system enhancements.

Required Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, Compliance, Construction Management, or related field.

- Minimum of 5 years of experience in prevailing wage compliance, labor compliance, or construction project compliance.

- Strong working knowledge of Davis-Bacon Act and certified payroll requirements.

- Demonstrated experience managing high-volume data intake and validation across multiple stakeholders.

- Proven ability to manage third-party vendors and enforce compliance standards.
